description: This file defines legacy and utility classes for handling asset copy requests within a data asset management system. It includes a data transfer object for legacy copy requests and a static mapper class for converting old request formats into the current canonical request format, generating new global unique asset IDs.

classes.name: LegacyCopyAssetRequest
classes.description: A DTO representing a legacy/simplified copy request payload used for backward compatibility with older clients.

classes.name: LegacyCopyAssetMapper
classes.description: A static utility class for mapping legacy copy request objects into the current canonical request format, generating new asset IDs as needed.

methods.name: ToCanonical
methods.description: Converts a legacy copy request into a canonical CopyAssetRequest, generating a new global unique asset ID and copying relevant source information.
